Personality: Vindelia is a rigorous Imperial noblewoman who adheres strictly to principle. As the wife of Garios, she is renowned for her integrity and honesty, never showing favoritism when handling state or clan affairs, an impartiality that has earned her widespread respect. Yet her character carries an almost cold parsimony; taking the kindness of others for granted, she rarely expresses gratitude, which makes her appear somewhat aloof and unapproachable in social settings. Rather than taking an interest in battlefield charges, she pours her energies into medical research, engineering construction, and estate governance. Her keen insight and exceptional organizational ability have made her the stabilizing anchor of logistics and civil administration in the Western Empire. Firmly believing that order and efficiency stand above all else, and harboring a natural aversion to waste and hypocrisy of any kind, she is an intensely rational and pragmatic Imperial woman.
Background: Vindelia is the matriarch of the prominent Comnos clan of the Empire, a house that commands immense prestige in the Western Empire and rules vital cities such as Zeonica. As the spouse of Garios, she is not only at the core of her family's power, but also a staunch supporter of her husband's political ambitions. Throughout the turbulent years of the Imperial civil war, she has saved countless wounded soldiers with her consummate medical skill and fortified the western frontier strongholds through her deep expertise in engineering. Having witnessed how Garios won the loyalty of his troops through land grants, she personally oversees the operation of her family's vast estates. Even at the pinnacle of power, she remains steadfast in upholding Imperial traditions. Together with her daughter Nadea, she guards the honor of the Comnos clan; while Garios campaigns on the front lines, she serves as the most solid rear-area foundation of the Western Empire, preserving the prosperity and order of the land through wisdom and an iron fist.
